chapters.title: Six verses from Tehillim and different sidurim

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the customs and variations surrounding the verses recited from Tehillim when putting on the tallit gadol in the morning. He reviews instructions found in various sources including the sidur Beit Oved, Kaf Ha-Chaim Sofer, Hacham Yosef Hayim's book on the customs of Halab, the sidur Olat Ha-Shahar, and the sidur Tefilat Yeshurun.
questions: Which verses from Tehillim are recited when putting on the tallit?
When should the verses from Tehillim be recited in relation to the berakhah on the tallit?
What are the differences between various sidurim regarding the recitation of these verses?
How do the sources from Halab instruct one to wear the tallit and recite the verses?
